title: Very happy with this walk!
text: The plot is boring, but this is not the point. It took us on a really interesting evening walk around the old town of Barcelona. Very happy! Definitely do after dark ;)
author: csemkov

title: Interesting
text: Very interesting, you walk through the city without realizing it and discover a lot of streets and details that you didn't know, calmly, at your own pace
author: E8995DBlaurag

title: a great experience
text: "We had a great time; we were expecting a mystery game, but it turned out to be more of a sightseeing tour. However, we thoroughly enjoyed it. We got to explore places and discover details in our city that we had never seen before."
author: Irenefernandez

title: A great way of experiencing a new city
text: While the individual missions may vary I quality, the general idea and experience is truly excellent!
author: Zantonius

title: Worth the Hunt!
text: We liked the game and trivia, it was fun and a great way to get learn interesting facts about Barcelona and see cool landmarks!
author: javiereN3842NX

title: 5 stars
text: Me and my wife had such a cool evening using this app. It took us to places in Barcelona that we wouldn’t have the chance to walk by without this game.
author: rodrigorB1411AA

title: One of the best ways to discover the city!
text: The game is fun and full of interesting information about the legends of the city. It can get really spooky! Also, as you walk by different parts of the city center, like Ramblas or Barrio Gótico, you get to see many stores, restaurants and buildings that you wouldn't otherwise get to know! A truly fantastic experiencie!
author: jimenaguerrero

title: Thrilling and spooky!
text: An amazing and very entretaing way to explore Barcelona. Each step of the way is fun and spooky! The game is full of thrills and exciting discoveries, that otherwise you might never know about.
author: jimenaguerrero

title: Such Fun!
text: It's a really good way to express the city on your own time and see bits you may not notice otherwise
author: Matthew P

title: History and Adventure
text: This was a great way to explore Barcelona. Full of history and adventure. It was so much fun! I highly recommend
author: danielbU7224AY
